title: Amazing way to see Granada from Seville
text: Awesome tour!!!! Super personal our driver picked us up (just 2 people) and drove us to Granada we stopped for a road side breakfast and had what felt like a very natural experience with locals before finishing our ride. Our tour guide at the Alhambra was amazing and she explained tons of history while answering our random questions!!! Then we got to spend an afternoon walking the city of Granada and exploring. Was an awesome tour extremely private and custom highly recommend!!!
author: Derek_P

title: Worth the trip!
text: Our driver Miguel arrived on time and very friendly. Our guide Simon was full of great information and helped my 78 year old father navigate the terrain. Simon took some amazing photos for us that we would have never thought to get and we will cherish. I highly recommend this excursion!
author: John_H

title: Amazing tour of Alhambra
text:
The car ride was in a very comfortable car. Great.  The tour guide met us Jenni was Fantastic.  The trip information from Viator did NOT mention photo Id was essential to get into the Alhambra.  Our guide Jenni from Saville Inside rescued us.  She contacted our hotel and they send images of our passports to her phone. This together with her local knowledge of the system got us in. 
The tour of the garden and palaces with her knowledge where brought to life.  Amazing !!
author: Lynn_C
